# Lab 17.1: Create a Data Exchange & Listing

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a private data exchange and publish a dataset as a listing that other projects can subscribe to.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create a dataset to share.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable analyticshub.googleapis.com
bq --location=US mk --dataset --description "Daily sales shared with partners" $PROJECT_ID:lab17_shared
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false '
CREATE TABLE lab17_shared.daily_category_sales AS
SELECT DATE(i.created_at) AS day, p.category, COUNT(*) AS items, ROUND(SUM(i.sale_price),2) AS revenue
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` i
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id = i.product_id
GROUP BY 1, 2'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Create the exchange.** **Governance → Sharing (Analytics Hub) → Create exchange**:
   - **Region**: US
   - **Display name**: `BQ Course Exchange`
   - **Primary contact**: your email
   - Keep it **private**.

3. **[Console] Create a listing.** Open the exchange → **Create listing**:
   - **Shared dataset**: `lab17_shared`
   - **Listing name**: `Daily Category Sales`
   - **Description, documentation, contact**: fill in short text
   - **Category**: Retail

   Click **Publish**.

4. **[CLI] List exchanges and listings with the API.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">TOKEN=$(gcloud auth print-access-token)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  "https://analyticshub.googleapis.com/v1/projects/$PROJECT_ID/locations/us/dataExchanges" | grep -E '"name"|"displayName"'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **[Console] Grant subscriber access.** On the listing, click **Set permissions** and give the subscriber (a colleague or your second project's account) **Analytics Hub Subscriber**.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Exchange | Private container for listings |
| Listing | Points to `lab17_shared` |
| Data | Not copied when published |
| Access | Subscriber role on the listing |
